questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

25*5*10*2*4*7
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option(3)

By using BODMAS and going by the options

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

**Given Equation: 25*5*10*2*4*7**

Interchanging * with signs

**Option(1) ×, ÷, -, +, =**

⇒25 × 5 ÷ 10 - 2 + 4 = 7 

⇒ 25 × 0.5 - 2 + 4 = 7

⇒ 12.5 - 2 + 4 = 7

⇒ 16.7 - 2 = 7

⇒ 14.7 = 7

**⇒ LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option(2) -, +, ÷, ×, =**

⇒ 25 - 5 + 10 ÷ 2 × 4 =7

⇒ 25 - 5 + 5 × 4 = 7 

⇒ 25 - 5 + 20 =7

⇒ 45 - 5 = 7

⇒ 40 = 7

**⇒ LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option(3) ÷, +, -, ×, =**

**⇒ 25 ÷ 5 + 10 - 2 × 4 = 7**

**⇒ 5 + 10 - 2 × 4 = 7**

**⇒ 5 + 10 - 8 = 7**

**⇒ 15 - 8 = 7**

**⇒ 7 = 7**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

**Option(4) ÷, ×, -, +, =**

⇒ 25 ÷ 5 × 10 - 2 + 4 = 7

⇒ 5 × 10 - 2 + 4 = 7

⇒ 50 - 2 + 4 = 7

⇒ 54 - 2 = 7

⇒ 52 = 7

**⇒ LHS ≠ RHS**

Therefore, only option(3) satisfies the above equation.

Hence, the correct is** an option(3)**

questions.question: If 15th October 2008 was a Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 14th October 2012?
questions.solution:
In any two consecutive ordinary years, date of the next year will be one day ahead of the same date of the previous year

15th October 2008 = Wednesday

15th October 2009 = Thursday

15th October 2010 = Friday

15th October 2011 = Saturday

If a leap year comes immediately after an ordinary year, then the day on a certain date of the leap year will be 2 days ahead of the same date on the ordinary year from March to December.

15th October 2012 = Monday(Leap year)

14th October 2012 = Sunday (One day before 15th October 2012)

Hence, the correct answer is **option(1)**.

**First number × 3 + 1 = Second number**

First pair = 18 × 3 + 1 = 54 + 1 = 55

**Statements:**

All 'alphas' are 'betas'.

No 'beta' is a 'gamma'.

Some 'thetas' are 'alphas'.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gammas are alphas.

II. Some thetas are betas.

III. No alpha is a gamma.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All 'alphas' are 'betas'.

No 'beta' is a 'gamma'.

Some 'thetas' are 'alphas'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91ddd196d6c671ba0365442599c020349aa66db9cfc3aa42840bc1ca908954cb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11bc31a52f65feed44eb3a59e59cc95c788493628b334925e3782b8e1967e86d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/893160047961d50f57b0e0f5550d3d40d9458d3264f2ea7b2b3a7b9dd861523c.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gammas are alphas.

II. Some thetas are betas.

III. No alpha is a gamma.

Conclusion 1 : False. Since all alphas are betas and no beta is gamma, that means no gamma is alphas. And conclusion I does not follows.

Conclusion II : True. All alphas are betas and some alphas are thetas, that means some thetas are betas as well. And conclusion II follows

Conclusion III : True. Since all alphas are betas and no beta is gamma, that means no alpha is gamma. And conclusion III follows

Therefore, **only conclusion II and conclusion II follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option(3)**

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

25 * 3 * 5 * 15 * 1
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS and going by the options

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

**Given equation :- 25 * 3 * 5 * 15 * 1**

Interchanging * with signs

**Option(1) =, +, +, +**

⇒ 25 = 3 + 5 + 15 + 1

⇒ 25 = 24

**⇒ LHS ≠ RHS **

**Option(2) +, =, +, -**

⇒ 25 + 3 = 5 + 15 - 1

⇒ 28 = 25 - 1

⇒ 28 = 24

**⇒ LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option(3) ÷, ×, ×, =**

⇒ 25 ÷ 3 × 5 × 15 = 1

⇒ 8.33 × 5 × 15 = 1

⇒ 624.75 = 1

**⇒ LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option(4) ×, =, ×, × **

⇒ 25 × 3 = 5 × 15 × 1

⇒ 75 = 75

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Only option(4) satisfies the above equation

Hence, the correct answer is** an option(4)**
